svg.text: APC mini mk2 · PhysicsVJ control map
grid note = row × 8 + col, row 0 at the bottom · factory mode, MIDI channel 1
WHOLE-SCREEN FX · purple, green when on (shift + pad = clear all)
SCENE QUEUE · palette colour · press = arm deck B, shift = cut
PALETTES · TEMPO (row 1) · LEVELS (row 0) · cyan, red when on
faders 1–3: trail / orbit / point size where the scene has them; 4–8: the live scene's physics (FADER_MAP in apc_mini.py)
LEDs: the live scene pad breathes with the level and jumps on kicks · PULSE flashes on detected kicks · TAP ticks with the tempo · FX pads breathe when on
Press animations: punch ripples, big punch flashes, re-fire / reset wipe, title curtains down, palette sparkles, scene cuts ripple in the new palette colour
